SELECT c.name AS customer, latest.id AS order_id, latest.ordered_on FROM customers c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.id, o.ordered_on FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o.ordered_on DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE c.id IN (1, 6) ORDER BY c.id;

WITH RECURSIVE team AS (SELECT id,name,0 AS depth FROM employees WHERE id=1 UNION ALL SELECT e.id,e.name,t.depth+1 FROM employees e JOIN team t ON e.manager_id=t.id WHERE t.depth<1) SELECT id,name,depth FROM team ORDER BY depth,id;

WITH RECURSIVE edges(a,b) AS (VALUES(1,2),(2,3),(3,1),(3,4)),walk(node) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT e.b FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.a=w.node) CYCLE node SET is_cycle USING path SELECT node,is_cycle FROM walk ORDER BY node,is_cycle;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month',ordered_on)::date AS month_start,sum(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY month_start), compared AS (SELECT *,lag(revenue) OVER(ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT month_start,revenue,previous_revenue,round((revenue-previous_revenue)/NULLIF(previous_revenue,0),4) AS growth_rate FROM compared ORDER BY month_start;
